atomicBoundaries.boundary: One existing synchronous enter/atomic transaction covers version identity/ledger, live successor/tombstone, all authority DB-carrier cleanup, group/position/floor metadata. Commit ambiguity keeps original fence/reopen rule; no separate MutationReceipt or key admission.
Service/owner/pump barrier serializes view eligibility, replay floor and complete erasure group publication; current policy drain alone neither tracks stream position nor scrubs queued content.

Each actual replica/consumer separately atomically applies whole group cleanup and durable checkpoint before its own publication. This is not a distributed atomic deletion of every remote copy at the authority commit; a replica not yet applying P remains behind under the existing route/wait/fail rule.

Keep original identity-level state; validate/reconcile staged imported history, rotate actual TX epoch and fence history namespace, publish ledger-first before binding/resuming ordinary visibility. Partial/uncertain activation remains unavailable, never silently live.

captureProofConflict: Existing D4 full raw postimage/report retention cannot automatically be reused as an erasure witness. Future exact evidence lifecycle must keep useful digest/lineage/fact proof while applying erasure to every actual controlled content copy, with no post-receipt reconstruction, edited historical evidence or weakened audit. This is a necessary proof-design review, not permission to delete old packets.

carriers.requiredHandling: Remove erased live record only with same-group valid successor/tombstone; preserve identity nonreuse and legitimate alias locator semantics, do not erase unrelated non-owning references.
Capture digest from original served record at version commit. Preserve pre-metadata form provenance; remove all content-bearing auxiliary fields after erasure.

Remove erased upserts/deltas/context/inline copies, preserve permitted lineage/execution order. Internal sanitization representation must not leak invalid wire upserts. Withhold created/updated/source-owned and graph facts only under exact per-Link-version condition; deleted lineage facts remain, original ordinals never renumber.

Destroy content in retained postimages and accidental diagnostics, retain immutable execution facts/body epoch/view/positions and page URL boundaries; serve existing erased vs withheld forms. Expiry promise does not defer erasure.

carriers.actualOrMissingSeam: creator_facts; live sequence responses/retained member facts
carriers.requiredHandling: Preserve key/allocated identity dependency meaning, remove any embedded erased content, project erased to authorized resource-erased else forbidden; no auto-resume sequence tail.
Scrub affected records/pages, retain required expired identities; pre-P receiving-view handles become410 cursor-expired regardless lifetime, new snapshot includes complete projected ledger.

carriers.actualOrMissingSeam: owner readers; eventScans WeakMap; service streams; pump current packet/frame and Node transport queue
carriers.requiredHandling: Revalidate/fence before additional publication. Already handed bytes not revocable; not-yet-handed pre-P content cannot cross fence, including backpressure. No distributed client-ack fiction.

carriers.actualOrMissingSeam: NEW identity-level ledger, per-view minimumReplayPosition and observability data
carriers.requiredHandling: Permanent across maintenance/history/epoch/view transitions; store only permitted lineage/record/digest; no retention expiration or rollback with history image.

carriers.actualOrMissingSeam: SQLite rollback journal/free pages; controlled backup/import images; OS/COW snapshots/logs/crash dumps where actually controlled
carriers.requiredHandling: Choose/review actual destruction or protected-key lifecycle and recovery procedure; plain SQL DELETE or projection denial is not proof of unrecoverability. Physical power-loss/media/snapshot assurance remains explicit, not claimed from process SIGKILL.

carriers.actualOrMissingSeam: declared consumer generations/caches/indexes; actual pre-act HTTP/stdout/report/trace bodies
carriers.requiredHandling: Each receiving holder applies erasure before its own further visibility and advances durable checkpoint atomically; unknown status discarded. Future raw captures are not exempt. Pre-act digest checking must release/sanitize original content before retained proof publication under a separately reviewed evidence contract. Historical unrelated packets are not retroactively edited.
